name: Nushrratt Bharuccha
bio: Nushrat Bharucha is an Indian film actress known for her work in Bollywood films. Bharucha made her acting debut with the 2009 box office flop Kal Kissne Dekha. The 2015 buddy drama Pyaar Ka Punchnama 2 marked her first commercial success.
